SELECT c.code, c.title AS name FROM CHALLENGE AS c WHERE c.progress_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND c.post_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.delete_yn = 0

SELECT main.code, main.name, sub.code AS sub_code, sub.name AS sub_name FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS main
JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY AS sub ON main.code = sub.main_cate WHERE main.status = 'active' AND main.delete_yn = 0 AND sub.status = 'active' AND sub.delete_yn = 0

SELECT main.code, main.name, main.status, main.created_by, main.created_at, main.updated_by, main.updated_at, main.delete_yn, sub.code AS sub_code, sub.name AS sub_name, sub.status AS sub_status, sub.delete_yn AS sub_delete_yn FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS main LEFT JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY AS sub ON main.code = sub.main_cate WHERE main.main_cate IS NULL
